title: Name, Registered Office & Objectives
text: The group shall be known as Amani Investment Chama. Registered office Nairobi, Kenya. Objectives: pool savings for collective investment; provide emergency loans; build financial literacy.

title: Membership
text: Maximum 12 active members. Admission fee Ksh 2,000. Exit requires 3 months written notice. Expulsion by 3/4 majority for: three consecutive missed contributions, fraud, or prejudicial conduct.

title: Monthly Contribution
text: Each member shall contribute Ksh 5,000 on or before the 5th day of every month.

title: Payment Method
text: All contributions via M-Pesa Paybill No. 247247, account number = member full registered name.

title: Late Payment Penalty
text: Contributions between 6th and 15th attract penalty Ksh 500.

title: Very Late Payment Penalty
text: Contributions after 15th attract penalty Ksh 1,000 in addition to standard contribution.

title: Non-Payment
text: Failure to contribute by month end = missed contribution. Three consecutive missed contributions triggers automatic expulsion review under Article 2.5.

title: Loans
text: Eligibility: 6 months active, no penalties. Max loan 3x personal savings. Interest 10% p.a. reducing balance. Repayment within 12 months. Two guarantors required. Default after 2 missed repayments — guarantors jointly liable. Emergency loans up to Ksh 10,000 at 5%, 3 months, Chair + Treasurer approval.

title: Governance
text: Officials: Chairperson, Vice-Chair, Secretary, Treasurer, Investment Officer — 2 year terms, max 2 consecutive. Removal by 2/3 at special meeting.

title: Meetings
text: Monthly meeting last Saturday 10:00 AM. Quorum 7 members including 2 officials. AGM each January. Three consecutive unexcused absences fined Ksh 500 per meeting from fourth onward.

title: Internal Resolution
text: All disputes referred to Chairperson for mediation within 14 days of dispute arising.

title: Committee Hearing
text: If mediation fails, dispute committee (Chair, Secretary, one elected member) hears within 30 days.

title: Binding Decision
text: Committee decision binding. Aggrieved party may appeal to full general meeting within 7 days.

title: External Arbitration
text: Unresolved disputes referred to Co-operative Societies Tribunal under Cap 490.

title: Late Contribution Dispute
text: Member provides M-Pesa confirmation. Treasurer verifies date on Paybill statement. Penalty per Article 3.3 or 3.4 based on verified date.

title: Loan Default Dispute
text: Treasurer presents repayment schedule and M-Pesa records. Member presents counter-evidence. Committee rules within 7 days.

title: Investment Loss Dispute
text: Investment Officer presents proposal, minutes, vote record. Losses shared proportionally.

title: Expulsion Dispute
text: Written notice and right to address general meeting before expulsion confirmed.

title: Financial Management
text: Bank withdrawals above Ksh 10,000 require Treasurer and Chair signatures. Monthly financial reports. Annual audit. No single investment above 40% of funds without 3/4 majority.
